cover.title: Lawrence Brownlee & Erin Morley
cover.subtitle: The Golden Age
cover.calloutLabel: A note from President and Executive Director
cover.pressQuote: Lawrence Brownlee is simply the finest lyric tenor before the public today—his voice of spun gold has few peers in the world, Opera News With its revival of Donizetti’s “La Fille du Régiment,” the Met followed up with another bel canto winner, this one carried by the irrepressible charm and flawless coloratura of the soprano Erin Morley. The New York Times

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: In arias and duets from the most beloved bel canto operas, soprano Erin Morley and tenor Lawrence Brownlee take audiences on a journey through love's many guises—flirtatious rivalry, innocent infatuation, fiery accusations, and joyful sincerity.
body: In arias and duets from some of the most beloved and beautiful operas of the bel canto period and beyond, soprano Erin Morley and tenor Lawrence Brownlee bring us on a journey through love's many guises. Flirtatious rivalry, innocent infatuation, fiery accusations, joyful sincerity: these frequent co-stars bring us a tapestry of the charm, dramatic prowess, and vocal fireworks that have won them admirers from around the world.

sections.title: Program
sections.lead: Bel canto arias + duets. Rossini Le Comte Ory, Verdi Rigoletto, Bizet Les Pcheurs de Perles, Delibes Lakm, Bellini Il Pirata, Donizetti La Fille du Rgiment. Presented with BLO.
